rows.label: tlk70000054_01_msg0001
rows.name:
We call ourselves the resistance, but
we're still a small group Adel-sama
formed only recently in Invidia.

rows.label: tlk70000054_01_msg0002
rows.name:
We may be small, but we've
got all sorts. Invidians,
Iirans, Gulans, Superbians...

rows.label: tlk70000054_01_msg0003
rows.name:
Because of that, many in Invidia may
want to use us as a convenient
military force.

rows.label: tlk70000054_01_msg0004
rows.name:
But that could provoke Iira and
Superbia, with whom we've built good
relations.

rows.label: tlk70000054_01_msg0005
rows.name:
As deputy leader, I'll never allow a
situation where my subordinates or I
fight our homelands.
